svg.font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'Malgun Gothic', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The parts of openDMT3. On the player's Windows PC the launcher (Tk, opendmt3/client) only reads the client data, makes openDMT3's own folder from it at PLAY (the client copy, the card reader library with the in-game layer, the settings, the card), and starts the game from there. Playing on this PC, the launcher runs the server inside itself; on another server, it signs in over the HTTP API for the player's card and records. The game logs in by card and sends its results over the game's own protocol. The server (opendmt3/server, with Docker or Python) is one process: the site and its API on port 4730 (Starlette), the game server on port 4725 (asyncio), their services, and one SQLite file. Both parts share opendmt3/core
